verdict.rationale: Bento documents workflows as visual automations that start with a trigger and run 'when this happens, do that' steps with branching, delays and decisions. Events, forms and tags all trigger these automations, and workflows can send webhooks to external systems. Flows can also be built from behavior, events and tags, with AI generation from plain text. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of workflow triggers, and detailed docs on the trigger/condition rule types (e.g., conditional filters on event properties).
